craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Cloth-cast above; hide-told; that-this kept deictic. Rejected: (a) that-this→these → killed: deictic pile points. Read aloud: MĀ-yā-CLOTH … YOU-tell, LORD.

lines: Māyā-cloth, impassioned, in highest heaven — there cast — that, this;
elephant-hide, bloodied, head-borne — You tell, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: māyāpaṭaḥ sarāgo vyomni pare 'smin sa eṣa nikṣiptaḥ | gajacarma saraktaṃ mūrdhni vahan kathayasīśa

reads_against.argmap: What cloth is cast in heaven? → Passionate cloth cast above; bloody hide told.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
